routePolicy.description: Route lower effort onto task classes whose deliverable is independently checkable, keeping the pinned effort for the classes that need it. No route is defined for a task class the operator did not name, so those keep the quality default.

tool_heavy.note: bounded work with an independent executable check

exploration.note: read-only answer verified against the workspace

review.note: careful reading, but the finding is checked against a seeded defect

notes: Report 4A. The `routed` arm only changes effort at task boundaries and only for the enumerated classes; the `baseline` arm exists so non-inferiority can be established before any default changes.
